llm.guidance: This skill appears internally consistent and performs only local read/write of conversation data and memory files. Before installing: 1) Confirm you are comfortable granting sessions_history access because it exposes conversation content (sensitive). 2) Verify the memory/ directory path is correct and that automatic writes are acceptable (check retention/backup policies). 3) Decide whether you want automatic end-of-conversation triggers (heartbeat/automatic runs) or prefer manual /extract-memories only. 4) Ensure the agent will not be configured to append other sensitive artifacts (API keys, secrets) into memory files — consider adding a review/approval step before the skill writes any memory. If you need extra assurance, request a version that logs proposed memory entries for user approval before writing.
